description: Default capability for the main window. T2: http (CORS-free API calls against the user's own server, no URL restriction — the address is entered at runtime), opener (external links) and os (device label). T4: notification (reminders as local notifications), dialog+fs (downloads to a user-chosen path, native file picker, share-file reads from the app cache dir). All cross-platform plugins — no platform scoping needed.
